name: Game Event Creature
description: Links creature spawns to a game event: the creature is spawned while the event is active (positive event id) or despawned for the event's duration (negative event id).

fields.name: Guid
fields.help: Creature spawn guid from the creature table.

fields.name: Event
fields.help: Game event id (game_event.entry), signed. Positive: the creature is only spawned while the event is active (if the guid is part of a pool, all pool members must be listed for the event). Negative: the creature is removed for the duration of the event and pool grouping is ignored. 0 is not allowed.
